assets.caption: Three engineering detail drawings showing flanged thermowell connection configurations for polypropylene piping T-24. Top-left detail shows NPS 3/4 through NPS 4 line size with eccentric reducer, NPS 1-1/2 fabricated branch connection, NPS 1-1/2 lap joint flange, NPS 1-1/2 lap joint stub end, line size x NPS 6 molded concentric reducer, 300 (12) (MIN) dimension, INSTR piping, and FIELD MAKE UP callouts. Top-right detail shows NPS 1-1/2 fabricated branch connection, NPS 1-1/2 lap joint flange, NPS 1-1/2 lap joint stub end, line size x NPS 6 molded concentric reducer, NPS 3/4 through NPS 4 line size, INSTR piping, and FIELD MAKE UP callouts. Bottom detail shows NPS 6 line size and up with NPS 1-1/2 lap joint flange, NPS 1-1/2 lap joint stub end, NPS 1-1/2 fabricated branch connection, INSTR piping, and FIELD MAKE UP callouts.
